title: Schoolverzuim 1979
authors: Lesman, C.M., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Pedagogisch didactisch instituut, PDI, Boorsma, J., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Vakgroep onderwijskunde, Meilof, J., Advies en begeleidingscentrum * Amsterdam (primary investigator)

descriptions: Finding causes of truancy at lower vocational training schools in Amsterdam. Appreciation of school / subjects of study / teachers / motivation / aspirations / absence from lessons / consequences / evaluation of teaching / favourite subjects / contacts with teachers, classmates and friends / parental involvement with school, career, leisure activities. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ education
